items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Mayan Perez's orchestra? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's the orchestra, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. He had a clean suit for going with us. I'm leaving Best Pete back. I can't remember. We had one, but I can't remember. That's Pete. He can tell.
What about Mayan Perez's orchestra? The one who was on the roof guard? Uh-huh. He had a fine orchestra. That picture we saw in this Jasmine, that's the man.
